reason: r1 is a Forge port of the "Lock-on Target V1" cheat: one entry hook on the hunter's target-camera tap logic writes the cheat's 5.0 into the local hunter's tap window right before the game reads it.

ai_code.scope: Researching the game code, and writing and testing this mod's code and documentation.
